description: This file defines interfaces and classes for WebSocket stream handling, including creation, connection, reading, writing, and error handling within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamRequest
classes.description: Interface for handling WebSocket stream creation requests.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI
classes.description: Extends WebSocketStreamRequest with methods used during handshake.

classes.name: WebSocketStream
classes.description: Abstract interface for WebSocket stream operations including read, write, and close.

classes.name: WebSocketStream::ConnectDelegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving connection results and handshake events.

methods.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnBasicHandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Called when a basic handshake stream is created.

methods.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnHttp2HandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Called when an HTTP/2 handshake stream is created.

methods.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnHttp3HandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Called when an HTTP/3 handshake stream is created.

methods.name: WebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnFailure
methods.description: Called when the WebSocket stream creation fails.

methods.name: WebSocketStream::CreateAndConnectStream
methods.description: Creates and initiates connection of a WebSocketStream.

methods.name: WebSocketStream::CreateAndConnectStreamForTesting
methods.description: Creates and connects a WebSocketStream for testing purposes.

methods.name: WebSocketStream::GetNetLogWithSource
methods.description: Returns the NetLog source for logging.

methods.name: WebSocketDispatchOnFinishOpeningHandshake
methods.description: Helper function to dispatch handshake completion info to delegate.
